name: Stormbringer: Surge of Might adds Nature damage to allied hits (#1395)
contract: #1395: Surge of Might (520083) reads "Emanate an aura around you for $520084d, causing allied players within $a yds to deal ${$spn*0.7} additional damage as Nature damage when they deal direct damage." Spell.dbc: 520083 Effect[0] = 142 SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID triggering 520084 with EffectBasePoints -1 + EffectDieSides 1 = 0; 520084 Effect[0] = aura 231 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE triggering 573254 and Effect[1] applies Exhaustion 573255; 573254 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with SchoolMask 8 (Nature). Two things were missing. 520084 has ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated no entry and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 without one: the aura landed and never fired. And the forwarded value was the raw effect value, 0, because nothing computed ${$spn*0.7}. The fix mirrors Neptulon's Wrath: a spell_proc row for 520084, a DoCheckProc restricting it to the owner's own non-periodic hits on an enemy, and a UNITHOOK_MODIFY_SPELL_EFFECT_BASE_VALUE hook adding 0.7 x the Stormbringer's Nature spell power to 520083's effect 0. Flask of the Frost Wyrm (53755) is the fixture's spell power source: its aura 345 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT has EffectBasePoints 124 + EffectDieSides 1 = 125 with MiscValue 127, which covers Nature. Fire Blast (2136) is only the ally's direct-damage carrier.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
Give the Stormbringer a known spell power
SETUP: the flask supplies at least 124 + 1 = 125 Nature spell power
BASELINE: the raid aura reaches the grouped ally
BASELINE: the ally is marked with Exhaustion
DISCRIMINATING: the aura carries 0.7 x 125 = 87.5 truncated to 87, plus 1 from EffectDieSides, instead of the forwarded 0 + 1
Let the Surge of Might global cooldown expire
DISCRIMINATING: the ally's direct damage procs the aura
DISCRIMINATING: the proc deals Nature damage 573254
